name: Kasukabe Yuki
source:
Ryuuji's childhood friend. A bright and energetic girl.
When at home, she handles things like housework very well, and seems like she has no flaws. But since she endures this all on her own, there seems to be aspects of herself that she tries to suppress.

After seeing Ryuuji again after such a long time, she's very happy.

[translated from Getchu]
